newsitem.title: USA: GM recalls 390,000 cars to fix wiper switch.
newsitem.headline: GM recalls 390,000 cars to fix wiper switch.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Monday it was voluntarily recalling about 390,000 vehicles to install a new windshield washer/wiper switch.
The recall includes model year 1994 Pontaic Grand Prix, 1994-1995 Buick Regal and Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme, and 1995 Chevrolet Lumina and Monte Carlo models, GM said.
Some of the vehicles may contain a strained or separated power feed wire that may cause the wiper to work intermittently, it said.
GM said it knew of no injuries or accidents that had occurred as a result of the problem.
